note: Gemini-only seats (PLAN.md 5.1, dated note 2026-09-27): the OpenAI key has no credit; every former gpt-5.5 seat moves to Gemini. Read at construction time by fsa.redo.llm_seats (host side; the in-trial overlay trigger reads it when its judge is first built). Environment overrides, recorded in every seat record: REDO_JUDGE_MODEL, REDO_JUDGE_EFFORT.

gemini.client: openai SDK chat.completions against Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; response_format json_schema (strict) or json_object; reasoning_effort -> Gemini thinkingLevel
gemini.patient_retry: transient errors (429, 500, 502, 503, 504, overload, timeout, connection): backoff 10, 20, 40, 60, 120, 180, 300, 300, 300 s (9 retries, +0-20 % jitter); invalid/missing JSON output: at most 4 retries (5, 15, 30, 60 s)

serves: SWE-Together in-trial overlay trigger (fsa.redo.intent_judge, v1 prompt) for new overlay trials
SWE-Interact no-dialogue LLM judge and in-trial overlay trigger (fsa.redo.swe_interact.judge)
SWE-Interact revelation tagger ('revealed by turn t'; fsa.redo.swe_interact.tagger)
E2 control tagger (fsa.redo.e2.items.tag_replies -> the revelation tagger)
SWE-Interact refactoring rubric grader, final verifier (EVAL_MODEL) and host-side per-snapshot rubric judge
judge.why: not an agent rung (no self-grading) and its own per-model quota (measured 26 Sep: 16 concurrent short calls clean, 429 at 32)

swe_interact_user_sim.note: SWE-Together's official simulator model, so both benchmarks share one simulator family. Recorded deviation from SWE-Interact's official gpt-5.5. Same per-model quota as the SWE-Together simulator (429 at ~4 concurrent short calls); patient retry in the sidecar (SWI_SIM_RETRY=1).

swe_together_correctness_judge.was: codex/gpt-5.5 (substitute for the official Claude Opus agentic judge)
swe_together_correctness_judge.replacement: final pass = the task's own tests/test.sh reward (the verifier result already in each trial) together with the frozen per-intent judge on the final snapshot (fsa.redo.metrics); Gate 1 depends on the per-intent judge only
